drawing.hint_none: Click a node, load, support or plate to edit it. Drag to rotate the model.
drawing.hint_member_start: Click a grid point or a node to start the member.
drawing.hint_member_next: Click the next point. Purple points leave the work plane, which then moves to that level. Click the last point again or press Esc to stop.
drawing.hint_plate_next: Click the corners of the plate in order.
drawing.hint_plate_close: Click the first corner or press Enter to create the plate. Esc cancels.
drawing.hint_support: Click a node to add the support (again to remove it), or a dark diamond to edit one.
drawing.hint_point_load: Click a node to add the point load, or a red diamond to edit one.
drawing.hint_distributed_load: Click the middle point of a member to add a uniform load along it, or an orange diamond to edit one.
drawing.hint_pressure: Click the middle point of a plate to add a uniform pressure over it, or a purple diamond to edit one.
drawing.hint_moment: Click a node to add the moment, or a green diamond to edit one.
drawing.hint_delete: Click a node, member, plate, support or load to delete it with everything that depends on it.
drawing.editor_detach_tooltip: Give this element its own parameter, so changing it leaves the others as they are
drawing.editor_no_fields: This element has no inputs to edit here.
drawing.editor_unlinked_one: has no parameter yet. Changing it creates one.
drawing.editor_unlinked_many: have no parameter yet. Changing them creates one.
drawing.editor_show_box: Show the box of this element
drawing.axes_global_tooltip: Components along the global axes X, Y, Z
drawing.axes_local_tooltip: Components along the plate's local axes (x along its first edge, z normal to it)
drawing.hint_assign_section: Click a member to give it the section, or press on one and drag over the others
drawing.hint_assign_material: Click a plate to give it the material, or press on one and drag over the others
